To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the A-NET parallel object-oriented total hardware and software architecture has been designed and built.

A-NET is: (1) a parallel object-oriented architecture for highly parallel computing, (2) a multicomputer architecture that consists of 1,024 node processors interconnected by a two-dimensional, mesh-type, wormhole-routing network, (3) a machine architecture with a 40-bit, 32-register processing element and a 40-bit router for message routing, (4) an operating system that supports the execution of parallel object-oriented applications on a parallel object-oriented multicomputer architecture
the A-NET architecture is a parallel object oriented total architecture that can be implemented with current technology.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a parallel object-oriented architecture, called A-Net, for highly parallel computation, and the design of a local operating system for each of the node processor.
parallel object-oriented computation.
a parallel object-oriented approach to the design of highly parallel computers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a parallel object-oriented architecture is feasible and practical.
the A–NET architecture is an efficient and powerful parallel architecture for highly parallel processing.
A-NET is an architecture for a multicomputer system that is capable of supporting highly parallel computations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have designed a parallel object-oriented architecture for highly parallel computations.
we have developed a parallel object-oriented programming language, a machine architecture and a local operating environment for a parallel multicomputer.
we have developed a new approach for parallel computation, called parallel object-oriented total computation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the design of a parallel object-oriented architecture can be done from the ground up.
a parallel object-oriented architecture is a feasible approach to building a parallel system.
the parallel object-oriented total approach to highly parallel computation is feasible and practical.
